6.105 rsInvalidScopeInTablix
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidScopeInTablix is a critical error that will occur when a RunningValue, RowNumber, or Previous
aggregate function within a Tablix does not contain as its Scope parameter a string constant that is
equal to the name of a containing group in the Tablix.
